title: Gate B human_paths become independent_paths, cleared by independent verification, and the self-deploy exclusion goes

story.as_a: the delivery loop changing a repo's self-modification code, loopctl itself or claude-config
story.i_want_to: have that change verified by a lineage-separated verifier dispatch on another runner with the end-to-end suite green at its head
story.so_that: such a change merges without Mark, and never on the word of the session that wrote it

rationale: PRD R4: 'Self-modification paths go to an independent holder, not to Mark' (in release 2, before holders exist, an independent verifier dispatch) and 'The Gate B human_paths list keeps its role, renamed independent_paths'. Today a human_paths match is a Gate B :human outcome (gate_b.ex:283-285) that refuses every merge (merge_precondition.ex:815-816) and escalates at triage (gate_b.ex:124-140); and every merge that redeploys loopctl or touches claude-config is refused as {:self_deploy_excluded, repo} for a human to merge by hand (merge_precondition.ex:70-99, 276-278, 423-430). This story replaces 'a human confirms' with three server-checked facts (a verifier whose lineage shares no root with the implementer's, on a server-attested other host, and the configured end-to-end check green at the head) on the pull-request route, and gives control-plane merges the same rule, so once runner and chg move into this repo (US-52.4, US-52.5) the loop can merge its own changes.

acceptance_criteria.description: Triggers.parse accepts only document version 2, whose repo keys are effect_paths, independent_paths, independent_checks (a non-empty list of check names) and limits, refusing a version 1 document {:unsupported_version, 1} and a repo entry carrying human_paths {:unknown_key, path}; RepoTriggers, TriggerDrift, mix loopctl.gates.measure_b and mix loopctl.gates.check_drift read independent_paths, and no 'human_paths' or ':human_path' remains in lib/.

GateB.evaluate(:merge, ...) names a match {:independent_path, file, pattern} with outcome :independent (renamed from :human) when every reason is an independent path, and MergePrecondition.judge/1 clears those reasons only when the fact :independent_verification is :ok, refusing {:independent_verification, reason} beside the paths otherwise; every other Gate B reason refuses exactly as today.

independent_verification/3 (tenant_id, story, opts) is {:error, :not_independently_verified} unless the story's recorded verifier dispatch passed Progress.merge_custody_status/1 at the recorded head (verified_head_sha == head_sha), whose verify_lineage_separated/4 refuses a verifier sharing a lineage root with the implementer; it is {:error, :same_host} unless that dispatch ran on a runner whose server-attested runners.name differs from every runner in the implementer's runner_dispatches rows, and {:error, :host_unattested} when the verifier or the implementer has no runner_dispatches row.

independent_verification/3 is {:error, {:independent_checks_not_passed, names}} unless every independent_checks name passed at the head, judged by CiEvidence.judge/2 over PullRequestSource.check_evidence(repo, head_sha, branch) for the stage row's branch and head.

GateB.triage_screen/3 returns effect_path matches only: a predicted touch of an independent path no longer escalates at triage, TriageVerdict's 'human_path:' screen code is deleted, and docs/agent-delivery-loop.md's Gate B section states the three facts instead of 'goes to a human'.

{:self_deploy_excluded, repo} and :self_deploy_excluded_repos are deleted: every merge into the control-plane repo (config :control_plane_repos, default mkreyman/loopctl and mkreyman/claude-config) carries {:independent_path, :control_plane, repo} and is allowed only when :independent_verification is :ok, with those repos' independent_checks naming the full end-to-end suite run at the head.

A control-plane merge the runner made but never reported, because the deploy restarted loopctl and dropped its socket, is recorded by the merge sweep after the restart: while the runner is absent after an instruction was pushed for the head, each merge sweep enqueues a read-only adopt job ("mode" => "adopt", sweep outcome :runner_absent_adopt_enqueued) that finds the pull request merged at the allowed head and adopts it as ci -> merged with its merge_sha, and PostDeployVerificationWorker carries it to deployed and verified once the deploy is healthy, with no human step and no :runner_gone escalation inside runner_gone_after_seconds/0.

test_cases.name: version 2 parses; version 1 and human_paths are refused; no human_paths left in lib (unit)
preconditions: three documents with their sha256: v2, v1, v2 carrying human_paths; the lib/ tree
expected_results: {:ok, triggers} with independent_checks; {:error, {:unsupported_version, 1}}; {:error, {:unknown_key, ["repos", r, "human_paths"]}}; no match

test_cases.name: an independent-path-only diff is :independent and clears only on :ok (unit)
preconditions: triggers with independent_paths lib/gate/**; a diff touching lib/gate/a.ex; a diff also over max_files
expected_results: outcome :independent with one {:independent_path, ...}; second has max_files_exceeded too; :allow; :refuse naming {:independent_verification, :same_host}

test_cases.name: the verification fact from custody and hosts (DataCase)
preconditions: fixture(:runner) minis and x1; implementer dispatch on minis; verifier B bound and verified at head on x1; twin story with B on minis; twin verified at an older head; twin whose verifier B shares the implementer's lineage root; twin whose verifier has no runner_dispatches row

test_cases.name: the end-to-end check must be green at the head (DataCase, PullRequestSourceMock)
preconditions: independent_checks ["e2e"]; mock check_evidence: e2e success at head, then e2e failure

test_cases.name: triage no longer escalates an independent path (DataCase)
preconditions: a triage verdict 'story' whose draft touches lib/gate/a.ex (fixtures of test/loopctl/delivery/triage_verdict_test.exs)

test_cases.name: control-plane merges are judged by independent verification, not refused by name (unit, judge/1)
preconditions: clean facts as merge_precondition_judge_test.exs builds them
steps: repo mkreyman/loopctl, diff runner/lib/x.ex, no verification fact
expected_results: :allow; :refuse naming {:independent_path, :control_plane, "mkreyman/loopctl"} and same_host; :refuse naming {:independent_verification, :not_independently_verified}; :allow; no verdict names self_deploy_excluded

test_cases.name: a self-merge whose runner never reported is adopted after the restart (DataCase, PullRequestSourceMock)
preconditions: a loopctl-repo story at ci with an allow and a merge_instruction recorded for head H; the runner's socket dropped 120 s ago; the mock reports the pull request merged at H with merge sha M
steps: PostDeployVerificationWorker.perform with a deployment that ships M
expected_results: ci -> merged with merge_sha M as control, no runner_gone escalation; then merged -> deployed -> verified

technical_notes: Config: Loopctl.DeliveryGates.Triggers (lib/loopctl/delivery_gates/triggers.ex:35-37 versions and keys, :159-167 repo parse); RepoTriggers (lib/loopctl/delivery_gates/repo_triggers.ex:15-20); GateB.usable/1 (gate_b.ex:256) requires independent_paths and independent_checks non-empty. No v1 shim (PRD section 4): the operator re-pins DELIVERY_GATES_CONFIG and its checksum in the same deploy, so CHANGELOG.md names the step and deploy/FLY_SECRETS.md the new key. Drift and measurement: TriggerDrift (lib/loopctl/delivery_gates/trigger_drift.ex:105-143), mix loopctl.gates.measure_b (lib/mix/tasks/loopctl.gates.measure_b.ex:227).

Gate B: human_path_reasons/2 (gate_b.ex:283) and the :human outcome; MergePrecondition.gate_b_reasons/3 (merge_precondition.ex:815) gains the :independent clause; the facts type (:226-243) gains optional(:independent_verification), and gather/3 (:1006-1028) resolves it only when Gate B or AC-52.12.6 produced an independent reason, so other stories pay no forge call.

Lineage separation is Progress.merge_custody_status/1 (lib/loopctl/progress.ex:4406) over verify_lineage_separated/4 (:4508), with custody_at_head/2 (merge_precondition.ex:900) binding it to the head; this story adds no second lineage comparison and compares dispatch lineages as today's code does (release 3 later moves that check to holder identity). Hosts: verifier B's runner is its runner_dispatches row (lib/loopctl/runners/dispatch_record.ex:76-77); runners.name is the attested machine (RunnerChannel refuses a join under another name, lib/loopctl/runners/runner.ex:6-9).

CI: PullRequestSource.check_evidence/3 (lib/loopctl/delivery/pull_request_source.ex:230) and CiEvidence.judge/2 (lib/loopctl/delivery/ci_evidence.ex:86); the e2e check is the end-to-end suite job (US-52.9). Triage: GateB.triage_screen/3 (gate_b.ex:124-140); screen_code/1 at lib/loopctl/delivery/triage_verdict.ex:1478. Docs: docs/agent-delivery-loop.md:169-180.

Self-deploy: delete self_deploy_reasons/1 (merge_precondition.ex:423-433), @default_self_deploy_excluded and self_deploy_excluded_repos/0 (:276-278, :389-400), the gather fact (:1014) and the moduledoc section (:70-99); control_plane_reasons/1 reads :control_plane_repos (case-insensitive, as today's match) and raises the independent reason for every merge into those repos, whatever paths it touches, because every green merge to master deploys. The exclusion tests at test/loopctl/delivery/merge_precondition_judge_test.exs:215-367 become TC-52.12.6's cases.

Reconcile after the restart: MergeExecution's sweep never enqueued a resend for an ABSENT runner, and a resend gated on the answer window would race the absence clock (both 600 s, the clock starting after the push), so an absent runner with a pushed instruction gets an adopt job on every sweep (absent_resend/2, adopt_if_merged/2), which only reads the verdict and records a merge at the allowed head; :already_merged is judged by the recorded allow, which already required verification, so the control-plane reason is not re-applied to it, and PostDeployVerificationWorker (lib/loopctl/workers/post_deploy_verification_worker.ex:1-5) carries merged pr-route stories to deployed and verified; the work here is the case test and keeping runner_gone_after_seconds/0 (merge_execution.ex:148) above loopctl's deploy restart, which the deploy measures and CHANGELOG.md records.
non_goals: Judging independent paths on the chg route when a change lands, and the hold that waits for verification: US-52.31a (it needs US-52.31's holder resolve edge).
Comparing verifier and implementer by holder identity instead of dispatch lineage: US-52.15 (release 3) switches verify_lineage_separated/4.
A chg-side check before chg lands: loopctl judges the landing it is told about; a pre-land query from chg to loopctl is not in PRD R4.
Server-side effect proof for effect_paths: unchanged.

failure_modes.partition: AC-52.12.7: a control-plane merge whose runner loses its socket in the restart is adopted from the forge's merged state by the next merge sweep, never lost; AC-52.12.4: an unreachable forge is the gate's existing :unevaluated refusal, retried.
failure_modes.state: AC-52.12.3: every input is a recorded row (verifier binding, verified_head_sha, runner_dispatches, runners) or the forge's check runs at the exact head; nothing a session says decides it.
failure_modes.retry: AC-52.12.2: judge/1 is pure over the gathered facts, so re-running the gate on the same head gives the same verdict; AC-52.12.7's adoption is MergeExecution's compare-and-set from ci, so a second sweep writes nothing.
failure_modes.slow: AC-52.12.4: the check read goes through PullRequestSource's bounded timeouts and is made only when an independent reason exists (technical_notes).
failure_modes.reach: AC-52.12.7: the adoption runs in the merge sweep on whichever loopctl node is up after the deploy, reading only Postgres and the forge.

definition_of_done: Production DELIVERY_GATES_CONFIG is a version 2 document re-pinned in the deploy, and mix loopctl.gates.check_drift passes against it.
A sandbox PR touching an independent path, verified on another runner with e2e green, merges with no escalation; the same PR verified on the implementer's runner is refused naming same_host.
A loopctl story touching lib/ merges through the loop after independent verification, and SELECT stage FROM story_stages for it reads verified after the deploy with no human event in its log.
defaults: independent_checks is configured per repo in DELIVERY_GATES_CONFIG; the sandbox, loopctl and claude-config entries name the end-to-end suite's check.
Control-plane repos: mkreyman/loopctl and mkreyman/claude-config (config :control_plane_repos); every merge into them needs independent verification, whatever paths it touches.
